title: PhysAlign: A Benchmark for Evidence-Grounded Role Alignment in Multimodal Physics Reasoning
abstract: arXiv:2609.33319v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: A key challenge in physics diagram understanding is correctly associating visual information with the physical entities, relations, and conditions it describes. Even when a value, symbol, or other local element is accurately recognized, assigning it to the wrong entity or scope can distort the underlying physical premise and lead to incorrect reasoning. To systematically study this challenge, we introduce \textbf{PhysAlign}, a benchmark designed to assess whether multimodal models correctly associate information recognized from physics diagrams with its intended physical role. By disentangling visual recognition from physical-role assignment through localized probes and controlled variants, PhysAlign isolates correspondence errors from recognition failures. translated_title: PhysAlign：多模态物理推理中基于证据的角色对齐基准
translated_abstract: 物理图像理解中的一个关键挑战是将视觉信息与其所描述的物理实体、关系和条件正确关联。即使某个数值、符号或其他局部元素被准确识别，若将其分配给错误的实体或范围，也可能扭曲潜在的物理前提并导致错误的推理。为了系统地研究这一挑战，我们提出了PhysAlign，一个旨在评估多模态模型能否将从物理图像中识别出的信息正确关联到其预期物理角色的基准。通过局部探针和受控变体将视觉识别与物理角色分配解耦，PhysAlign将对应错误与识别失败分离开来。该基准包含3,341个经人工验证的探针，覆盖986个物理问题，能够对视觉识别和物理角色对应关系进行大规模的系统性评估。我们进一步……
tldr: 提出了PhysAlign基准，通过解耦视觉识别与物理角色分配的局部探针（3,341个人工验证探针、986个物理问题），系统评估多模态模型能否将物理图像中识别的信息正确对应到其预期物理角色。
en_tdlr: PhysAlign is a benchmark of 3,341 human-validated probes across 986 physics problems that disentangles visual recognition from physical-role assignment to systematically evaluate whether multimodal models correctly associate recognized diagram information with its intended physical role.
